take: Pittsburgh announced it recalled center Avery Hayes from Wilkes-Barre/Scranton (AHL) and placed left defenseman Samuel Girard on injured reserve. Girard has been a top-pair defenseman at 18:12 a night, and in his nine games the Penguins have controlled 58 percent of the 5-on-5 expected goals (the quality of chances) when he plays, about 7 points better than without him. In the two games since he went out, Declan Carlile has moved in beside Korczak, Spencer Stastney is up to 19:44 a night from 14:39, and Erik Karlsson is up to 25:55 from 22:34.
